dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible as high-contrast, sharp white spots and edges against a dark blackish-gray background on the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, irregular, high-contrast red patch located on the upper nape/posterior crown.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low-contrast and poorly defined boundary between dark gray and black regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent large white oval patches on the lateral scapular regions and distinct white barring visible on the outer rectrices.
